name: Adam Laxalt
desc: 33rd Attorney General of Nevada from 2015 to 2019
summary: Adam Paul Laxalt ( LAK-sawlt; born August 31, 1978) is an American attorney and politician who served as the 33rd Nevada Attorney General from 2015 to 2019. Laxalt is the son of Pete Domenici, who represented New Mexico in the U.S. Senate, and the grandson of Paul Laxalt, a former governor and senator from Nevada. He is a member of the Republican Party.
